identity.notes: Use the probe serial, not the relay's BLE address; a MeatNet node can advertise on a probe's behalf. Redact real serials from logs.

methods.notes: BLE matching combines service and manufacturer evidence as available. The 01 pattern is product type, after the company ID, not a match on the company-ID bytes themselves. A passive client can decode the 23-byte manufacturer payload without connecting.

identification.notes: Match company 0x09C7 with product type 1 in the first payload byte after the two company-ID bytes, or the Probe Status service in scan response. Product type 2 is repeated MeatNet data; 3 Gauge, 4 Display, 5 Booster and 6 Engine are outside this spec. Serial zero means no probe.

device.name: Combustion Predictive Thermometer (Probe V1 / V2+)
device.notes:
Phone-direct monitoring and control of the eight-thermistor Predictive Probe. Advertisements provide temperatures without a connection; Probe Status adds log range, prediction, food-safety and alarm state; the UART service carries requests and responses. Cloud relay is optional.
This is deliberately a Probe profile. MeatNet Display/Booster routing, Giant Grill Gauge and Engine supplements, and DFU have different boundaries. Product type 1 selects this decoder. Preserve unknown product types and do not feed a MeatNet node's request/response envelope into the Probe UART parser merely because they share the Nordic UART UUID.

openness.notes: The published protocol is authoritative but still a draft. Static app review resolves little-endian fields and the response success byte's inclusion in CRC coverage; those implementation facts remain reported.

upstream_docs.covers: Advertisements, 94/100-byte status, sensor bit packing, UART message catalog and CRC.

enter_pairing_mode.notes: Outside the charger the probe advertises without a pairing button or PIN.

exclusivity.notes: Three simultaneous BLE connections are documented; do not apply MeatNet's different four-connection limits to the Probe.
exclusivity.recovery: The probe supports three centrals, not one. Close enough clients to free a slot if advertisements become unconnectable.

unpair.notes: There is no bond to remove; disconnect the central.

credentials.notes: No account password, network key or pairing secret is used by the reviewed direct BLE paths.
stored_on_device: Probe ID/color, power and prediction/alarm/food-safety settings
Current cook session and log buffers; no OS pairing bond is required

factory_reset.description: Do not present the cook-session reset as a factory reset. No bond or Wi-Fi credential exists to clear on the direct Probe profile.
factory_reset.effect: No factory-reset procedure or credential wipe is established. UART message 0x0A only resets the current cook: it clears prediction and data buffers and starts a new session immediately.

methods.description: Decode advertisements passively, or connect for Probe Status and UART. Normal advertisements are about 250 ms apart; Instant Read repeats delays of 100, 100 and 50 ms. Normal connection intervals are 400-500 ms, Instant Read 7.5-75 ms.

steps.action: Remove the probe from its charger so it advertises.
Match product type 1 and decode the 13-byte temperature block, or connect and subscribe to Probe Status.
steps.expect: Normal mode supplies eight temperatures; Instant Read supplies only thermistor 1 and zero placeholders in the other slots.

steps.action: For UART operations, subscribe to TX before writing RX, then run one request/response transaction at a time.
Read firmware/hardware/model information before deciding whether V1 power/RSSI behavior or V2+ behavior applies.

setup.notes: No provisioning, account or OS pairing is needed. Outside its charger a probe advertises continuously and accepts up to three BLE connections; it becomes unconnectable when all three are occupied.

rejoin.notes: No network membership or bond exists. A new client can passively scan or connect whenever fewer than three centrals already hold the probe.

steps.action: Close one existing client if all three connection slots are occupied, then rediscover by product type/service.

testing.notes: Not driven against a probe by this project. The vendor's public BLE specification is marked DRAFT. Byte order and response CRC coverage were cross-checked against vendor app 3.3.13 (versionCode 964) and the pinned community integration; no live capture or hardware result is claimed.

variants.notes: High-radio-power preference bit 0 means normal +0 dBm. Use this bit when comparing RSSI, not an assumed model-name string.
The same preference bit 1 means +8 dBm, approximately 8 dB stronger RSSI at equal distance. It does not identify a different protocol.

entities.name: Thermistor 1 (tip)
entities.notes: Decode protocol_details.temperature_decoder from advertisement or Probe Status. The only valid slot in Instant Read.

entities.name: Thermistor 2
entities.notes: Unavailable in Instant Read, where its raw zero is a placeholder.

entities.name: Prediction Time
entities.notes: Packed 17-bit value in Probe Status prediction block; interpretation is removal or resting according to prediction type.

entities.name: Overheating
entities.notes: Eight-bit mask; any set bit means at least one named thermistor is overheating.

entities.name: Silence Ordinary Alarms
entities.notes: Critical overheat alarms cannot be silenced by this command.

evidence.app_static_analysis: inc.combustion.app 3.3.13 (versionCode 964), reviewed without executing it, establishes little-endian CRC storage, 16/32-bit status fields, and the response success byte's inclusion in CRC coverage. No vendor internal symbol is reproduced in this spec. The app is not a hardware result.

artifacts.description: DRAFT Probe and MeatNet protocol documents.
CRC byte order/coverage and status scalar endianness only; no live operation.

evidence.documentation_review: combustion-inc/combustion-documentation at 89f2f24d1563b5279dee8b1ef23bac2beeddca85: Probe advertising, status, prediction/alarm layouts, UART and MeatNet product boundaries. legrego/homeassistant-combustion at 1e6764dd38b9b36ee0caea92d7c07611fde731f6 cross-checks the 13-byte little-endian thermistor unpacking and advertisement product routing.
evidence.open_questions: Exact model/revision strings and DRAFT changes per firmware; UART request segmentation above the default ATT MTU; real 94/100-byte status captures; log timing/order and backpressure; DFU; Gauge/Engine and MeatNet extras.

enter.notes: Public Probe DFU details are TBD. Do not infer bootloader entry from the UART service or send a guessed command.

image.notes: The vendor app delivers updates, but image format/authenticity was not established.

initialization.notes: The initial notification can repeat older Normal-mode state with session ID zero; that is normal.
Subscribe to UART TX before any RX write; responses may fragment or coalesce.

Log_Record.description: Payload of one type-04 log response, 24 bytes.

Manufacturer_Data.description: Probe advertisement as 25 bytes including the two little-endian company ID bytes c7 09. Most host APIs remove those two bytes and expose only the remaining 23 bytes; offsets below include them for an unambiguous map.

fields.name: serial
fields.notes: Zero means no probe; never publish an owner's serial.

fields.name: mode_id
fields.notes: Same bit layout as Probe Status offset 21.

fields.name: battery_virtual
fields.notes: Same bit layout as Probe Status offset 22.

fields.name: network_info
fields.notes: Unused on a direct Probe; MeatNet uses hop information.

fields.name: preferences
fields.notes: Bits 0-1 power mode; bit 2 high radio power.

UART_Response.description: One Probe UART response frame; header seven bytes plus payload.
UART_Response.example: ca fe ca 21 03 01 06 78 56 34 12 e8 03  (session 0x12345678, 1000 ms, success)

fields.description: Same message type as request; this is not MeatNet's high-bit response marker.
fields.name: message_type

fields.description: Exactly payload_length bytes; total frame is 7 + length.
fields.name: payload

parse_rules: Scan to ca fe only after discarding a malformed candidate. Wait for seven header bytes, then for 7 + payload_length total bytes; a one-byte length is inherent to this Probe protocol.
Verify CRC before decoding. A failure success=0 is a completed response, not a transport error; unknown message types remain undecoded.
After one valid frame, parse any following bytes as another frame. Do not assume one notification equals one response.

crc.name: CRC-16/CCITT-FALSE
crc.response_coverage: message type, success, payload length, payload

excluded_surfaces.destructive: Food-safety configure/reset and cook-session reset are not passive monitoring. Only reset_cook_session is exposed, advanced; configure/reset food-safety remain undocumented as commands here.
excluded_surfaces.dfu: The public Probe document leaves its Nordic DFU details TBD. The Nordic UART UUID is not evidence of a bootloader service or entry command.
excluded_surfaces.gauge_engine: Separate vendor supplements and capabilities; not inferred from eight-probe thermistor behavior.
excluded_surfaces.meatnet: Nodes use 10-byte request and 15-byte response headers with request/response IDs and a high response bit; do not use the Probe six-/seven-byte parser.

status_layout.common_bytes: Offsets 0-93 inclusive as declared on the characteristic. New session_id is offset 94 LE32; sample_period offset 98 LE16 ms.

product.notes: Enumeration depends on mode; preserve unknown codes.

status_layout.missing_session_rule: Treat a 94-byte status and session_id=0 in a 100-byte status as normal unspecified values. The first notification after subscribe may repeat Normal state with zero until measured.

prediction_status.packed_endianness: little, bit zero is the first field's bit 1

status_test_vector.notes: Entirely synthetic: invented serial/session and exact decimal thermistor values; no probe data.
status_test_vector.old_94_byte_rule: Remove the final six bytes (78 56 34 12 e8 03); all common fields keep their offsets and session_id becomes unspecified.

temperature_decoder.algorithm: Require exactly 13 bytes. Let packed = int.from_bytes(block, 'little'). For thermistor i = 1..8, raw_i = (packed >> (13 * (i - 1))) & 0x1fff; temperature_c = raw_i * 0.05 - 20. This is not eight big-endian values. The 13-bit wire range maps to -20..389.55 C, while the vendor's stated valid measurement range is -20..369 C (raw <= 7780); reject larger raw values rather than displaying them as food temperatures.
temperature_decoder.instant_read: In mode 1 only T1 is a reading. Slots T2..T8 contain raw zero placeholders, not eight real -20 C measurements. In Normal mode raw zero is the legitimate -20 C encoding.

virtual_sensors.packed: Take the battery/virtual byte as an integer. Core = (byte >> 1) & 0x07, surface = (byte >> 4) & 0x03, ambient = (byte >> 6) & 0x03.

remaining_unknowns: Actual firmware/model strings and which builds emit 94-byte versus 100-byte status; the DRAFT can change.
UART RX behavior when a request exceeds the negotiated ATT payload; no universal 20-byte fragmentation rule is asserted.
Log response pacing, end-of-range behavior and whether every record is always a separate response frame.
Food-safety product enum beyond preserving it, integrated-mode validation, and safe read-modify-write behavior.
DFU service/entry, image signing and recovery; MeatNet routing, Giant Grill Gauge and Engine details are separate profiles.
A real factory reset (if any) is unknown; UART 0x0A is only a new-cook reset.
The schema cannot express packed 13-bit thermistors or the other packed prediction/food-safety fields declaratively; the dedicated decoder and vectors are required.

characteristics.name: Model Number
characteristics.notes: UTF-8 model/revision; the public spec leaves exact values open.

characteristics.name: Serial Number
characteristics.notes: UTF-8 serial; treat as owner-private and do not log it.

characteristics.name: Hardware Revision
characteristics.notes: UTF-8; use with the radio-power preference bit for V1/V2+ behavior.

characteristics.name: Firmware Revision
characteristics.notes: UTF-8; reconcile with the DRAFT status layout before assuming session fields.

format.name: raw_temperature_data
format.notes: Eight consecutive unsigned 13-bit values in a 104-bit little-endian integer; scale 0.05 C and value offset -20 C.

format.name: probe_id_zero_based
format.notes: Displayed probe ID is this value + 1 (0..7 maps to IDs 1..8).

format.name: virtual_sensors
format.notes: Core bits 1-3 of the shifted field; surface next 2; ambient next 2. Use protocol_details.virtual_sensors.

format.name: overheating_mask
format.notes: Bit 0 is T1 and bit 7 is T8; 1 means overheating.

format.name: high_alarms
format.notes: Eleven uint16 LE alarm records: T1..T8, Core, Surface, Ambient.

format.name: session_id
format.notes: Only present in 100-byte form. Zero is a normal unspecified value, not an error.

characteristics.name: Probe Status
characteristics.notes: Accept exactly 94 bytes (older firmware without session ID/sample period) or 100 bytes (current layout). All integer fields are little-endian; packed bitfields number bit 1 from the least significant bit of the first byte. Decode the packed subfields with protocol_details.status_layout, not fixed offsets beyond each block.

read_logs.advanced_reason: Large log ranges can produce many responses and keep a battery-powered probe busy. Bound the range to the advertised min/max sequence numbers and read incrementally.
read_logs.description: Type 04 with inclusive start/end uint32 LE sequence numbers. Expect a sequence of 24-byte log payloads, each in its own response.

crc.description: CRC-16/CCITT-FALSE over 04 08 <start LE32> <end LE32>; computed by the dedicated handler, not a schema auto role.

read_over_temperature.description: Type 06; one-byte response payload, 1 means the over-temperature flag is set.

read_session_info.description: Type 03, empty payload. Response has session uint32 LE and sample period uint16 LE ms.

reset_cook_session.advanced_reason: This discards the active prediction and log buffers and starts a new session. Export any needed logs first; recovery is only starting a new cook, not restoring the old one.
reset_cook_session.description: Type 0A, empty payload. Clears prediction and data buffers and starts a new cook immediately; not a factory reset.

set_high_low_alarms.advanced_reason: This replaces high and low alarm configuration for all eleven sensor/virtual-sensor positions. Read both arrays first and preserve unrelated records and tripped/alarming read-only bits; an error can suppress or create a cooking alarm.
set_high_low_alarms.description: Type 0B with 44 bytes: eleven high-alarm records followed by eleven low-alarm records, uint16 LE each, in T1..T8/Core/Surface/Ambient order.

alarm_data.description: Read current high/low arrays and change only intended records. Per record: bit 0 set, bit 1 tripped (ignored on write), bit 2 alarming (ignored on write), bits 3-15 temperature raw = round((C + 20) * 10), range -20..799 C.

crc.description: CRC-16/CCITT-FALSE over 0b 2c and all 44 alarm bytes. All 44 zero gives 0x60d2, bytes d2 60.

set_prediction.description: Type 05 with two-byte packed prediction: setpoint in bits 0-9 (0.1 C), mode in bits 10-11 (0 none, 1 removal, 2 removal+resting).

crc.description: CRC-16/CCITT-FALSE over 05 02 <prediction_data LE16>. Example is 0x7035, bytes 35 70.

prediction_data.description: raw = round(setpoint_c * 10) | (mode << 10). Setpoint must fit 0..102.3 C and mode must be 1 or 2 for a real prediction. 69.5 C/mode 2 = 0x0ab7.

silence_alarms.description: Type 0C, empty payload. Silences ordinary alarms but deliberately not critical overheat alarms.

characteristics.name: UART RX (client to probe)
characteristics.notes: Request bytes are CA FE, CRC-16/CCITT-FALSE little-endian, type, payload length, payload. CRC covers type/length/payload only. The public docs do not specify a 20-byte request fragmenter; write a whole request when the negotiated ATT payload permits and do not borrow MeatNet or Hunter framing.

characteristics.name: UART TX (probe to client)
characteristics.notes: Response: CA FE, CRC little-endian, type, success (1 success/0 failure), payload length, payload. CRC covers type, success, length and payload. Accumulate the byte stream, honoring split and coalesced frames; validate length and CRC before dispatch. The success byte is part of response CRC coverage even though the DRAFT table does not call it out separately.
